title: Role-scoped source catalog
description: A catalog of source pointers grouped by agent role, not fetched content or authorization to execute operations. Legacy collector input formats are outside this schema.

resources.description: Sources relevant to this role. URLs may recur across roles. URL-only uniqueness within a role must be checked separately.

url.description: An absolute HTTP(S) address, or an empty string for a missing source. An MCP endpoint is a service pointer, not document content.

kind.description: Application-specific source category (for example gh_file_md, slack, or mcp_grafana), not a MIME type. New kinds do not imply fetching support.

context.description: Role-specific relevance, authority, caveats, and operational boundaries. Used as the collector output title.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the reference, not proof that its contents are correct or reachable. Omission means unknown.

access.description: Expected access requirements, not a credential or permission grant. Omission means unknown.

lastVerified.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the last check described in verificationNote; null or omission means no recorded check. Does not imply a full content review.

verificationNote.description: Scope and evidence of verification, such as path existence versus authenticated content review. Never include credentials.
